messages:
anika: heads-up — docs CI failing on linkcheck for /getting-started/quickstart. Seems Docusaurus slugify is dropping emoji but our cross-page fragment links still include the emoji text. example causing CI: /guides#using-the-:sparkles:-feature -> 404 :cry:

matt: saw the logs — about 12 broken anchors. headings like 'Using the :sparkles: feature' generate slug 'using-the-sparkles-feature' but some older markdown explicitly link to '#using-the-:sparkles:-feature'. mismatch.

sophie: I can patch the broken links with a small PR. prefer normalizing the explicit links to the slugified form (ascii) rather than editing the headings. saves churn.

tariq: agree. also worth updating the Docusaurus slugify options / remark-slug so future files generate stable slugs. we should document the canonical slug format in CONTRIBUTING.md.

matt: quick grep/sed to find candidates (untested):
```bash
git grep -n "#:using-the-" docs/ || true
# then a replace example:
# git grep -l "#using-the-:sparkles:-feature" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's/#using-the-:sparkles:-feature/#using-the-sparkles-feature/g'
```

anika: please don't mass-sed without reviews. sophie, open a PR limited to the files CI flagged, with a short explanation + test run. add me as reviewer. :eyes: :thumbsup:

sophie: will do. plan: (1) fix explicit fragment links, (2) normalize a couple of SDK snippets that had CRLF issues, (3) add a tiny pre-linkcheck script that verifies anchor presence. I'll include the grep/safe-replace commands in the PR description.

docs-bot: preview deploy for branch 'sophie/emoji-anchor-fix' is ready — https://deploy-preview-412.docs.redwood-inference.com (expires in 7 days)

matt: thanks. also noticed a Swift SDK snippet in quickstart rendered inline because code fence had CRLFs. fixed by normalizing fences: replace "```swift\r\n" -> "```swift\n" (we should add a docs linter rule).

tariq: long-term: add a docs-lint rule to forbid emoji tokens in explicit anchor links and a mapping table in our slugify config for common emoji -> word fallbacks. opened internal ticket INFRADOCS-2345 to track.

anika: perfect. assigning @matt and @tariq as reviewers for the PR. sophie — please tag the ticket number in the PR body and leave a short note about the regex so we can revert if it overreaches.

sophie: tagged and pushing the PR in ~10m. thanks everyone!
